author: Techlore
description:
Is Apple's privacy as good as they say? No, but it's better than most big tech, making tools like iCloud end-to-end encryption and Lockdown Mode incredibly accessible. I argue real tradeoff is their closed ecosystem, which blocks the advanced open-source privacy tools you can get on Android.
